title: D2: research/advisor.py TasteAdvisor wrapping a UserModel: D1 ranking, D2-D4 defaults with disagreement records, low-confidence fallback, never touches thresholds
summary: research/advisor.py TasteAdvisor over WS A's UserModel (taste.usermodel.load_model) or a ProfileUserModel adapter (D1 only). D1 = log(k*P(choose)) x Calibration.weight; D2-D5: statistics decide when decisive, taste is the default only in the inconclusive zone and can never accept; low confidence -> R0; failures logged and ignored. Tests: AdvisorTests incl. eager-taste-cannot-relax-evidence and real m1 model.
